name: Product Roadmap
description: Plan and track features from concept to release.

columns.name: planned
columns.label: Planned
columns.description: Features committed to the roadmap but work has not started.
columns.hint: Move here when a feature is scoped and added to the roadmap.

columns.name: in_development
columns.label: In Development
columns.hint: Move here when engineering work begins on the feature.

columns.name: in_review
columns.label: In Review
columns.description: Development complete — in QA, design review, or stakeholder sign-off.
columns.hint: Move here when development is done and the feature needs validation before release.

columns.name: released
columns.label: Released
columns.description: Feature shipped to production and available to users.
columns.hint: Move here when the feature is live and the release is announced.
